result.description: Manager Core and UI.Core timer handles ignore Restart overlapping Stop or Dispose, cancel in-flight callbacks without deadlock, allow a new fresh-token Restart after Stop returns, and never restart after Dispose. Operator approved 2026-10-08 in the Phase 2 rebrand repair.
result.title: Stop and Dispose take precedence over overlapping Restart

acceptanceCriteria.text: Restart while Stop or Dispose is in progress cannot create a new callback run or change the stored interval.
Stop/Dispose cancel the active token before waiting for a synchronous callback and return without external rescue when that callback cooperates with cancellation.
Restart after Stop returns uses a fresh uncanceled token; Dispose is final and repeated stop/dispose calls remain safe.
